A negative answer to the question of Adams, Freese, Nation and Schmid (J. Austral. Math. Soc. Ser. A
63 (1997)) whether the complement of a maximal sublattice of a finite semidistributive lattice is an
interval, as it is for bounded lattices, and so a counterexample to Hypothesis 1 of Adaricheva, Mata,
Silberger and Zamojska-Dzienio (DMTCS 28:2 (2026), doi:10.46298/dmtcs.16374). In a 26-element
semidistributive sublattice of K × K, K a 14-element semidistributive lattice, the diagonal is a
maximal sublattice whose complement has two minimal and two maximal elements.

Attached: the paper (PDF), its LaTeX source with the figures as PNG, and the arXiv tarball. The
repository contains the Lean 4 proof with Mathlib (ten theorems, standard axioms only), the C and
Python checks, and the dated priority check.

Author: Deep Bhattacharjee (ORCID 0000-0003-0466-750X).
